question:
In the given figure, the circle with centre O has radius 10 cm. The radius of the circle with centre P is x. STR is a common tangent to the two circles at points R and S as shown in the figure. RT = 16 cm and TS = 24 cm. What is the value of x (in cm)?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/133cb6d9cc6795379d73b424161b5e3a75cac1b338ef5ca6924c11210e186302.png]
solution:
**Given:**

The circle with center O has a radius of 10 cm

STR is a common tangent to the two circles at points R and S

RT = 16 cm 

TS = 24 cm

**Concept Used:**

When two lines intersect each other the opposite angles are always equal

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/133cb6d9cc6795379d73b424161b5e3a75cac1b338ef5ca6924c11210e186302.png] 

As we can see, Line RS and Line OP intersect each other 

⇒ therefore, angle RTO = ​​angle STP

Let angle RTO be y

In triangleROT

⇒ tan y = (RO)/(RT)=(10)/(16)

similarly,

In triangleSTP

⇒ tan y = (SP)/(ST)=(x)/(24)

As both the angle are equal, so we get

⇒ (10)/(16)=(x)/(24)

⇒ x = (10×24)/(16) = 15 cm

⇒ **Hence, The radius of the circle of center P is 15 cm.**
